# Security-critical paths. The gate (scripts/security_gate.sh) reports changes
# to them, and lists those with no dedicated automated check yet; later phases
# add each area's tests to the gate. Patterns can be added, never removed.
# The gate reads this file from the default branch, so edits here take effect
# only after they merge; a PR can't loosen the list for itself.
# One extended regex per line, matched against the repo-relative path.
# Paths that don't exist yet are listed so the gate is in place before the code is.

# Access model: row-level security, masking, grants, roles
(^|/)[^/]*(rls|row[-_]level|security[-_]polic|masking|grant|role|permission)[^/]*$
^db/security/

# Enforcement layer and the agent's identity and tools
^enforcement/
^agent/(tools|identity|auth)/

# Infrastructure and CI
^infra/
\.(bicep|tf)$
^\.github/

# The design the access model is built from
^docs/architecture\.md$

# Agent instructions: weakening these weakens every future setup run
^\.claude/
^\.vscode/
\.code-workspace$
^docs/security-setup-prompt\.md$

# Secret-scan allowlist: adding an entry here hides a finding from CI
^\.secrets\.baseline$
^\.pre-commit-config\.yaml$
^\.gitignore$

# Security tooling and its tests
^scripts/
^tests/
